parameters.command:
=#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

CLUSTER='{{ $json.cluster }}'
export KUBECONFIG="/tmp/pdb-policyreport-${CLUSTER}.kubeconfig"
trap 'rm -f "$KUBECONFIG"' EXIT

{{ $json.ocLogin }}
printf 'cluster\tnamespace\tpolicy\trule\tresult\tmessage\tresources\n'
# Kyverno PolicyReports can be stale; evaluate its PDB rule against live status.
oc get poddisruptionbudgets -A -o json | jq -r --arg cluster "$CLUSTER" '
.items[]
| select((.metadata.namespace | test("^(kyverno$|kube-|openshift-)")) | not)
| select((.spec.selector.matchLabels // {} | length) > 0)
| select((.status.expectedPods // 0) > 0)
| select((.status.disruptionsAllowed // 0) == 0)
| [
    $cluster,
    .metadata.namespace,
    "pdb-replicas-audit",
    "pdb-replicas-audit",
    "fail",
    "PDB will block eviction of \(.status.expectedPods) pod(s)",
    "PodDisruptionBudget/\(.metadata.name)"
  ]
| @tsv
'

=#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

credential=$(n8n export:credentials --all --decrypted | grep -o '\[{.*\}]' | jq -c '.[] | select(.name == "Registry_API_Credential") | {clientId: .data.name, clientSecret: .data.value}')
client_id=$(jq -er '.clientId' <<<"$credential")
client_secret=$(jq -er '.clientSecret' <<<"$credential")

curl -fsS -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  --data-urlencode 'grant_type=client_credentials' \
  --data-urlencode "client_id=$client_id" \
  --data-urlencode "client_secret=$client_secret" \
  'https://loginproxy.gov.bc.ca/auth/realms/platform-services/protocol/openid-connect/token' \
  | jq -er '.access_token'

parameters.content:
## Current PDB eviction audit

Runs every Sunday at 10:00 PM, America/Vancouver. It reads live PodDisruptionBudget status for gold, golddr, silver, klab, clab, emerald, and klab2, applying the same conditions as Kyverno's `pdb-replicas-audit` rule: an eligible namespace, a nonempty `matchLabels` selector, `expectedPods > 0`, and `disruptionsAllowed = 0`. Stored Kyverno PolicyReports can be stale, so notifications use current PDB status. It then gets Registry contacts for each affected licence plate.

Credentials are named `PDB_reader_<cluster>` and use the shared OC Login component (workflow 28). `Registry_API_Credential` stores the Registry client ID and secret.
